The '''2025 Retro League Event 1''' was the first event of the [[2025 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]] (19 January – 2 March 2025), played in [[Premiere - Hoth]] format.<ref name="t85237" /> [[Andy Talaga]] won.<ref name="t85237" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 19 January – 2 March 2025
* '''Players:''' 84 (in the posted standings)
* '''Winner:''' [[Andy Talaga]]

== Final standings ==
Final standings as posted by the tournament director (posted as images), in posted order.
